description: This file defines a command handler class for assigning staff to a group in the Fineract project. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, processes the assign staff command for a group, and delegates the operation to GroupingTypesWritePlatformService.

classes.name: AssignGroupStaffCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles the 'ASSIGNSTAFF' command for groups, facilitating the assignment of staff via the associated platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the assign staff command by invoking the service to perform the assignment, returning the result.
